Pairs with the Our-Free-model plugin (dsh-our-free-model): its free lane is the roster this panel dispatches into.","id":"gh:1391888226","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-agent-dispatch","slug":"Napstablooky233/dsh-agent-dispatch","topics":["agent","agent-dispatch","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","free-model","our-free-model","workflow"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Visible dispatch panel for DeepSeek Harness - decide whether other agents help, pick free-lane helpe"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"rs, and inject the division-of-labour policy. Pairs with the Our-Free-model plugin (dsh-our-free-mod"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"el): its free lane is the roster this panel dispatches into."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-agent-dispatch · Agent Dispatch"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> One settings pane: decide whether the main agent gets help, which helpers play — and it **actually"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" works**. Policy is injected as a `systemPrompt` section; save and it takes effect."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **Pairs with Our-Free-model.** This panel ships no provider of its own: it dispatches into the fre"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"e lane that plugin exposes, and every factory-default helper is one of its models. Details in Pairs "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"with the Our-Free-model plugin."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Visible**: one settings section showing status, channels, and helper roster (with measured TTFT)"},{"id":"p5s2","text":".
- **Actionable**: master switch / four-mode selector / channel checkboxes / helper checkboxes / co"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ncurrency limit / extra notes — change and save.
- **Actually effective**: policy text is a function"},{"id":"p5s4","text":", re-evaluated every step; when disabled it injects an explicit "no dispatch this turn" instruction."},{"id":"p5s5","text":"
- **Speaks first**: the default stance scans every turn for a possible split instead of waiting to "},{"id":"p5s6","text":"be named, and never hands the "should I dispatch helpers?" question back.
- **Self-checking**: befor"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"e each run the agent answers one line — can this split into independent blocks? — and a helper that "},{"id":"p5s8","text":"stops producing gets its work reassigned, then handed to a fallback."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it solves · Why it saves tokens"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The main agent resends the full context (system prompt + history) every step, billed by `cacheMiss` "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"— the biggest line on the token bill. Independent helpers each have their own context, and the free "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"lane has zero cost for input and output. So the key to saving money isn't "talk less", it's **moving"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" self-contained work out**. This plugin manages "what to move, to whom, how many"."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Division of labor (hard-coded in injected text): simple, mechanical, self-contained work that does n"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ot depend on main-session context (bulk retrieval, item-by-item audit, copy-edit-reorder, list makin"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"g, translation, formatting, first drafts) goes to free-lane helpers; the hardest, most judgment-heav"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"y, consequence-sensitive parts (architecture and key design, cross-module reasoning, correctness and"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" safety judgments, dispute resolution, final delivery) stay with the main agent."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Pairs with the Our-Free-model plugin"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"This panel ships no model provider. It picks a lane and a roster, and the lane it assumes is **Our-F"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ree-model** (`dsh-our-free-model`, measured at v2.7.2). Install that plugin and the free lane stops "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"being a slogan: the models exist, cost nothing per token, and show up in this panel's roster with a "},{"id":"p10s4","text":": the models exist, cost nothing per token, and show up in this panel's roster with a measured TTFT."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"What is already wired together:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **The roster peer defaults to `our-free-model`.** `peer` is `'our-free-model'` out of the box, and"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" every factory-default `helpers` entry carries that provider prefix — `our-free-model:nemotron-3-ult"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ra-free`, `our-free-model:ling-3.0-flash-fin-free`, and so on. Without the plugin those keys point a"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"t a provider the machine does not have; with it they resolve to live models.
- **The built-in refere"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"nce roster is that plugin's model list** — an 11-row `our-free-model` snapshot tagged "built-in", so"},{"id":"p12s6","text":" the panel is never empty on first open.
- **Nothing here is a hard dependency.** No provider is req"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"uired: `peer` only decides whose name the reference roster sits under, and an absent provider remove"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"s labels, not features. Any other provider works the same way — point `helpers` at it and the inject"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"ures. Any other provider works the same way — point `helpers` at it and the injected policy follows."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Install order: Our-Free-model first (so the free lane exists in `/models`), then this plugin, then r"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"estart `dsh` once so both bundles load. Reverse the order and the panel still opens; it just shows k"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"eys pointing at an absent provider until the lane is there."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Panel overview"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Eight sections, top to bottom:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Section | Content |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Master switch & four-mode selector | On / Off; four modes: Off / Ask me / Proactive / Auto |
| Hel"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"per channels | workflow fan-out / single subagent / Agency experts / Agent Teams; unchecked channels"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" go to the deny list |
| Helper roster | Three merged sources (host-registered / lane probe / manual"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" + built-in reference), each row labeled with source; ★ marks the default primary |
| Dispatch scale"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" | Max simultaneous helpers (1–8), step threshold for dispatch, whether short tasks are blocked from"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" dispatch |
| Pre-flight estimate | Whether every run starts with a one-sentence estimate; the minim"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"um independent block count that makes a team worth building; whether a passing estimate may build th"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"e Agent Teams team on the spot |
| Stall failover | How many steps without output count as stalled, "},{"id":"p17s9","text":"how many reassignments per unit of work, and who finishes it afterwards (main agent, or a named chec"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"ked helper) |
| Extra notes | Written verbatim into injected text |
| View injected text | Expand to"},{"id":"p17s11","text":" see the **actual** policy sent to the agent, not a mockup |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Top also has **first-run guide** (four steps, shown once) and **host adaptation check** (explains wh"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"y each feature is present or absent). On first run the sidebar's settings area also shows a compact "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"**onboarding card** with its own layout: "Open settings" jumps straight here, "Not now" reads it onc"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"g card** with its own layout: "Open settings" jumps straight here, "Not now" reads it once and done."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Compatibility and graceful degradation"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`inject = []` + nested fiber opportunistic acquisition of `webServer` / `systemPrompt` / `llm` three"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" services. **Any one missing only loses the corresponding feature; plugin remains usable**:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- No `webServer`: panel API unavailable (browser half cannot read/write config), but `systemPrompt` "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"section still injects.
- No `systemPrompt`: policy not injected (panel changes don't take effect), b"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ut API and roster work normally.
- No `llm`: roster only has lane probe + built-in reference + manua"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"l; manual entry of one `provider:model` still works.
- No services at all: panel still usable (pure "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"in-memory config + built-in reference roster)."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Write failure is not fatal: config updates memory first and takes effect immediately; panel shows "w"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"rite failed, will revert on restart"."}],"truncated":true}
